title: Lighting Design
shortDescription: Site review, prop layout, power plan and a 3D preview before anything is ordered.
description: Every project starts with a design pass. We review your photos and dimensions (or walk the site), map rooflines, trees and sightlines, and plan power and data runs so the installation is clean and serviceable. You receive a layout showing where each prop goes, which package it fits, and an itemised quote with installation crew-days and travel.
bullets: Power and data routing with weatherproof enclosures
Itemised quote: kit, crew-days and travel

title: Kit Supply
shortDescription: Controller box, microphone, pixel controller and props, configured before they ship.
description: Each kit ships with the Raspberry Pi 5 controller box already running the Light Show engine, a pixel controller set up for your props, a USB microphone, and 12 V WS2811 props built to your layout. Lifetime access to the software is included, with updates.
bullets: Raspberry Pi 5 Light Show controller box
Pixel controller and power, sized to the layout
USB microphone and 12 V WS2811 props

title: Installation
shortDescription: Two-person crews anywhere in Canada, billed by the crew-day plus zone travel.
description: Our crews mount props, run power and data and commission the show on site: Setup wizard, port tests on every prop, microphone calibration with your music playing, and a look check. We hand over the Light Show app on your phone before we leave. Installation is available in any city in Canada; it is billed by the crew-day, plus travel by zone and accommodation on multi-day jobs outside Saskatchewan.
bullets: Roofline clips, tree frames and anchoring for local weather
Mic calibration and look check with your music
Handover and training on your phone

title: Care & Seasonal Service
shortDescription: Pre-season checks, theme changeovers, repairs, takedown and storage.
description: Kits change character with the calendar. Care visits cover pre-season checks and repairs, theme and playlist changes for each season, re-running the mic calibration and look check if your sound system changes, software updates, and takedown and storage for seasonal props.
